'''Wishful Thinking''' was a [[Cracian thumper]] who raced at the [[Heatherdowns Hotel and Track]]. During a race that occurred while the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] merchant [[Hamar-Chaktak]] met with a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents regarding a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] theft, bookmakers gave Wishful Thinking 5:2 odds. Hamar-Chaktak placed a 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] bet on the Cracian thumper.<ref name="The Bacta Heist" />
